rules.note: A valid identity document: ID card or passport.
A photograph of you taken within the last year.
Diploma or temporary graduation certificate of your latest completed level (high school for bachelor, bachelor for master, master for doctorate).
Transcript of your latest completed level.
National exam results, if any. International exam results (GRE, GMAT, SAT and similar) only if your chosen university or programme requires them.
International language test results (for example TOEFL, DELF) only if your chosen university or programme requires them.
A proposal for your research topic. Doctoral applications only.
A written example of research you have carried out. Doctoral applications only.
